title: LH-1 capability comparison with Opentrons Flex and Hamilton Microlab STARlet
lh1_status: Designed and simulated only. Nothing built or measured. Two open problems in the tool-exchange latch and coupling. Every LH-1 figure is DESIGNED, not measured.

column_notes.LH-1 MVP: First-stage build defined in the brief: one carriage, one fixed eight-channel 30-300 uL pipette, passive deck (tip rack, reservoir, two plates, tip waste), no modules, no gripper, no tool exchange. Not designed in the project files.
column_notes.LH-1 starter: Size S of the LH-1 family (CAD machine_family S, ADR-011, ADR-014).
column_notes.LH-1 large: Size L of the LH-1 family (CAD machine_family L).

rows.LH-1 MVP: Defined in the brief only (one carriage, fixed eight-channel 30-300 uL, passive deck, no modules, no gripper, no tool exchange). Not designed, built or simulated.
rows.LH-1 starter: Designed and simulated only (CAD and calculation). Nothing built or measured. Second independent check (24 Nov 2026): two open blockers in the tool-exchange latch and coupling; verdict 'not worth building as designed' at the lab's run sizes.
rows.LH-1 large: Designed and simulated only. Layout rule-checked; ADR-011 says the large layout was not interference-checked at that date.
rows.Opentrons Flex: Commercial product, on sale; published specifications.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: Commercial product (Microlab STAR line); published specifications.
rows.notes: Every LH-1 figure below is DESIGNED (CAD, calculation or planner simulation), not measured.

rows.capability: Footprint W x D x H
rows.LH-1 MVP: Not designed: no CAD, simulation or wiring exists for this configuration in the files read. The frame width and height are fixed across the family, so an MVP in the starter frame would be no smaller than the starter (inference).
rows.LH-1 starter: 1,456 x 894 x 1,190 mm with extraction fan (1,344 wide without). Bench area with clearances 1,706 x 994 mm; needs a bench at least 894 mm deep. DESIGNED.
rows.LH-1 large: 1,456 x 1,114 x 1,190 mm with fan. Bench area 1,706 x 1,214 mm. DESIGNED. (Intermediate M: 1,456 x 1,004 x 1,190.)
rows.Hamilton STARlet: 1,124 mm wide (1,387 mm with multi-probe head per brochure; 1,450 per manual) x 781 mm deep (brochure; manual says 795; autoload about 1,006-1,011) x 903 mm high.
rows.notes: LH-1 figures disagree between ADR-011 (starter 1,292 x 894 x 1,140) and the CAD/ADR-014 (1,456 x 894 or 897 x 1,190); the CAD is newer. Hamilton's brochure and manual disagree on depth and on width with the multi-probe head.

rows.LH-1 starter: About 150 kg, ESTIMATE (modelled parts plus assumed tools, modules, electrics); 155 kg loaded. Four people or a lift table.
rows.LH-1 large: About 171 kg, ESTIMATE. (M about 160 kg.)
rows.Hamilton STARlet: 135 kg with 8 channels; 150 kg with multi-probe head.
rows.notes: ADR-011's 125/131/139 kg are superseded by the CAD estimates.

rows.LH-1 MVP: Passive deck: one tip rack, one reservoir, two plates, tip waste (as defined in the brief).
rows.LH-1 starter: 18 deck places on a 132 x 110 mm grid in 4 rows, plus a person-loaded 1,000 uL tip rack on the shelf, a shelf with tip-supply towers, an 8-bay pipette dock. Several places are dedicated (thermocycler and its lid park, cold blocks, tip frames, tip parking, tip and liquid waste, magnet, shaker, plate stack). DESIGNED.
rows.LH-1 large: 28 deck places in 6 rows (adds a balance and a weighing nest, a second plate stack, extra tube racks, a second magnet, two empty places), plus shelf towers and two edge hand-off positions. DESIGNED. (M: 23 places plus shelf rack.)
rows.Opentrons Flex: 12 ANSI/SLAS slots reachable by pipettes, plus 4 staging slots (gripper only).
rows.Hamilton STARlet: 30 tracks: up to 5 six-track carriers of 5 plate or tip-rack positions each (25 SBS positions if the whole deck is used that way), or up to 30 single-track tube carriers of 24 or 32 tubes. Work area 675 x 465 mm; labware up to 140 mm tall.
rows.notes: ADR-011 states 16/20/25 places for S/M/L; the CAD reports 18/23/28 deck places. Counting conventions differ (shelf rack, edge column).

rows.LH-1 MVP: SBS plates, one reservoir, one tip rack (brief). No tube handling (no single channel).
rows.LH-1 starter: SBS-footprint plates (thermocycler takes 0.2 mL 96-well full-skirt plates); 12-column reservoir; strip carrier; tubes 1.5/2 mL (24 ambient, 48 cooled), 5, 15 and 50 mL in a cooled block; tube work by single channels only (eight-channel pitch does not fit tube racks). Height limits by deck rule (51-100 mm next to worked places). DESIGNED.
rows.LH-1 large: As starter, plus ambient racks for 5, 15 and 50 mL tubes and a 4-trough 73 mL reservoir. DESIGNED.
rows.Opentrons Flex: Plates with 12-384 wells (12-48 wells single-channel only), deep-well plates, reservoirs, tube racks for 0.5-50 mL tubes, aluminium blocks, 96-tip racks; custom labware by JSON definition.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: All SBS plates up to 1,536 wells and most commercial tube types (brochure); tube carriers of 24 or 32 tubes; labware up to 140 mm.

rows.LH-1 starter: Two tool carriages, each takes any tool. Tool set: eight-channel 0.5-10, 5-50 and 30-300 uL; single-channel 0.5-10, 10-100 (bay reserved) and 100-1,000 uL; a 10 mL syringe dispense tool (optional, refused by firmware until commissioned). Each pipette tool is a bought hand pipette in a machined cradle, plunger pressed by a motor on the carriage. DESIGNED.
rows.LH-1 large: Same head and tool set as the starter (width, head and dock are fixed across sizes). DESIGNED.
rows.Opentrons Flex: Two mounts: any two 1- or 8-channel pipettes (1-50 or 5-1,000 uL each), or one 96-channel (1-200 or 5-1,000 uL) across both mounts.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: 8 independent channels (brochure spec table), 1,000 uL channels covering about 0.5-1,000 uL by tip (10, 50, 300, 1,000 uL tips) and optional 5 mL channels (50-5,000 uL); optional CO-RE 96 or 384 multi-probe head. Independent Y spacing and Z per channel.
rows.notes: STARlet maximum channel count beyond 8 was not found in the pages read (the manual covers 4-16 channels for the STAR line).

rows.LH-1 starter: Yes, DESIGNED: 8-bay dock, tools passive, kinematic coupling of bought balls, vees and a pull stud, latch opened by a dock lift bar. About 92 s per exchange (head report). OPEN PROBLEMS: two blockers in the latch/coupling (keyhole alignment during exchange; sideways load on the coupling). Coupling repeatability (0.10 mm needed) is unproven.
rows.LH-1 large: Same as starter.
rows.Opentrons Flex: No. The user attaches and removes pipettes with captive screws, then runs a probe calibration. The gripper sits on its own extension mount.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: No pipette exchange; channels are fixed. Channels can pick up tools (CO-RE gripper paddles) during a run.
rows.notes: The machine-family report gives 52.9-53.5 s per exchange; the head report and ADR-014 give 92.3 s after the dock lift was added.

rows.LH-1 starter: No. Picking up fewer than eight tips with an eight-channel tool is not designed in (an option that is switched off; it needs a bench test first). Single-well work goes to single-channel tools.
rows.LH-1 large: No (same).
rows.Opentrons Flex: Yes: 8-channel 2-7 consecutive tips or a single tip; 96-channel a column, a row or a single tip; rack must sit directly on the deck.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: Inherent: each channel picks up its own tip, so any subset of channels can be used; CO-RE 96/384 heads pipette full or partial plates.
rows.notes: The second check names part-column pick-up as one condition for LH-1 to match the bench at small runs.

rows.LH-1 starter: None measured. No machine accuracy is claimed. The bought hand pipettes' own specifications do not transfer to a motor-driven plunger; bench test CT-6 (accuracy after exchange, by weight) is planned, not run.
rows.LH-1 large: None measured.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: Published (1,000 uL channel, disposable tips): 1 uL CV 4.0 %, trueness 5.0 %; 10 uL (10 uL tip) 1 %, 1.5 %; 50 uL (50 uL tip) 0.75 %, 2.0 %; 200 uL (300 uL tip) 0.75 %, 1.0 %; 1,000 uL 0.75 %, 1.0 %; 0.5 uL 6.0 %, 10.0 %. 'Test criteria available upon request.' x-y-z positional accuracy 0.1 mm. Each instrument ships with a Declaration of Quality of its final-inspection pipetting results.
rows.notes: Commercial figures are the makers' own claims under their test conditions.

rows.LH-1 starter: No pressure or capacitive sensing (the hand pipettes have none). Planned checks, all DESIGNED and unproven: through-beam tip gate; side camera for tips on, straight and liquid in tip; head camera reading deck markers; overview camera recording runs. Checks can only hold a run. A dock bay and cable are reserved for a future bought pressure-sensing channel. No weighing in the starter.
rows.LH-1 large: As starter, plus a weighing nest and a 0.1 mg balance on the deck (dispense checked by weight where resolvable; ADR-005 expects a few mg, i.e. roughly 5-10 uL and above).
rows.Opentrons Flex: Pressure sensing for liquid detection: one sensor on 1-channel; channels 1 and 8 only on 8-channel; A1 and H12 only on 96-channel. Capacitance (contact) sensors on the same channels. Optical tip-attachment sensor on all pipettes. One 2 MP deck camera for recording.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: cLLD (conductive liquids, needs conductive tips) and pLLD (all liquids, individual channels only); TADM per-channel pressure curves against tolerance bands in real time (software option); MAD (detects clots, empty wells); Anti-Droplet Control for volatile liquids; capacitance-based clot detection.

rows.LH-1 MVP: One tip rack (96 tips) and tip waste (brief).
rows.LH-1 starter: Tip frames on deck refilled by the gripper from shelf towers of nested tip wafers: held 3,648 tips (300 uL 2,208; 200 uL 480; 10 uL 864; 1,000 uL 96 in a person-loaded rack); random-access parking for 48 300 uL tips; tip waste chute to a 29 L crate (about 12,400 tips). DESIGNED.
rows.LH-1 large: Held 6,144 tips across 9 shelf towers and deck frames; tip waste crate about 11,100 tips. DESIGNED.
rows.Opentrons Flex: 96-tip racks in deck slots and staging slots; Stacker holds up to 6 tip racks each, up to 4 Stackers per Flex. Trash bin or waste chute fixture.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: Tip racks on carriers (5 per 6-track carrier); tip waste on deck; autoload option loads carriers and reads barcodes. No dedicated tip stacker found in the pages read.
rows.notes: The project's tip_supply.txt gives 1,248 held 300 uL tips for the starter against the CAD's 2,208 (flagged by the second check).

rows.LH-1 starter: Gripper on its own Z axis on the head: moves plates and lids between deck, cold blocks, thermocycler, shaker, magnet, a 4-plate stack and lid parks; refills tip frames. No open edge hand-off position in the starter. Gripper jaw force has no data (ADR-014). DESIGNED.
rows.LH-1 large: As starter, plus a second plate stack and two edge hand-off positions for instruments beside the machine. DESIGNED.
rows.Opentrons Flex: Flex Gripper (optional, USD 9,750 list): fully skirted plates, lids and tip racks across deck, staging slots and modules. No payload or force figures published on the page read.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: CO-RE Gripper (two channels pick up paddles): plates, lids, archive and filter plates. Optional iSWAP: plates 5-43 mm tall, grip 5-16 N, 300 g, +/-0.5 mm, reaches off deck for third-party devices. Optional tube gripper (8-20 mm tubes).

rows.LH-1 starter: Custom TC-1: one zone, 96-well 0.2 mL plate, 4-99 C block (design figure), heated lid, motorised lid, over-temperature cut-outs. DESIGNED, not built.
rows.LH-1 large: Same TC-1.
rows.Opentrons Flex: Thermocycler Module GEN2: block 4-99 C, lid 37-110 C (+/-1 C), up to 4.25 C/s heating, 2.0 C/s cooling, 96-well. USD 10,230-11,980 list.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: An on-deck thermal cycler (Inheco ODTC class) 'can be integrated on the deck of all STAR Line liquid handling platforms' (2014 trade press). Not confirmed on a current maker page.

rows.LH-1 starter: A bought USB heater-shaker at one deck place, moved by the gripper only; host interface designed; NO MODEL CHOSEN, so speed and temperature range are not fixed. DESIGNED.
rows.LH-1 large: Same.
rows.Opentrons Flex: Heater-Shaker Module: 37-95 C (+/-0.5 C at 55 C), 200-3,000 rpm, 2.0 mm orbit, powered plate latch. USD 4,150-5,650 list.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: Hamilton Heater Shaker (HHS): up to 2,500 rpm, up to 105 C, orbits 1.5-4.0 mm (search summary of the maker page); several units via a control box (brochure).

rows.LH-1 starter: Passive magnet block MB-1 on the deck; the gripper moves the plate onto it. DESIGNED.
rows.LH-1 large: Adds a second, low-elution-volume magnet. DESIGNED.
rows.Opentrons Flex: Magnetic Block GEN1: passive, 96 N52 ring magnets on a spring bed; gripper moves plates on and off. USD 1,750 list.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: No Hamilton magnet module in the brochure read. A magnetic-bead STARlet configuration with one heater-shaker and one magnet exists (search summary); third-party magnet plates are used on carriers.

rows.LH-1 starter: Four Peltier thermal modules (cold plate, cold strip carrier, 48-tube cold block, 5-50 mL tube block), planner range 4-40 C. No 37 C position (reserved, not fitted in any size). DESIGNED.
rows.LH-1 large: Same four modules. DESIGNED.
rows.Opentrons Flex: Temperature Module GEN2: 4-95 C, 24-well, 96-well, deep-well and flat blocks, no shaking. USD 3,975-5,475 list.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: Hamilton Heater Cooler for SBS plates (range not stated in the brochure); Cooling Carrier Module for samples (range not stated).

rows.capability: Other modules (plate reader, stacker, HEPA, UV)
rows.LH-1 starter: No plate reader. 4-plate stack (gripper only). UV-C (254 nm, on the door interlock) and a roof fan-filter unit are RESERVED options, not fitted. Edge hand-off for external instruments not open in the starter. DESIGNED.
rows.LH-1 large: As starter, plus two edge hand-off positions. Plate reader possible as a deck module or at an edge hand-off (not chosen). DESIGNED.
rows.Opentrons Flex: Absorbance Plate Reader (450/562/600/650 nm, 0-4.0 OD, needs gripper); Stacker (6 tip racks each, up to 4); HEPA/UV Module (H14 filter, ISO-5 claim after a 15 min cycle, 254 nm UV-C, interlocked to the door).
rows.Hamilton STARlet: STAR CAP clean-air hood option ('turns the STAR into a laminar flow hood'); UV Kit; autoload; iSWAP for off-deck third-party devices; Liquid Dispenser module. Plate reader and stacker: not found as Hamilton deck modules in the pages read.

rows.LH-1 starter: Full enclosure, polycarbonate front door with a coded type-4 safety sensor (stops motion), e-stop, dual-channel safety relays and contactors, over-temperature cut-outs, host-loss watchdog, extraction fan with airflow switch, tools held by a latch on power loss. Designed TOWARD EN ISO 13849-1 Cat 3 / PL d, NOT verified. NO electrical or machinery safety assessment: must not be used until a competent person has assessed it.
rows.LH-1 large: Same.
rows.Opentrons Flex: Steel and aluminium frame, polycarbonate windows and front door; E-stop pendant required at all times. Complies with IEC/UL/CSA 61010-1 and 61010-2-051, EN 61326-1. Whether opening the door stops motion is not stated on the pages read.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: Fully covered by acrylic covers; front cover has a magnetic switch monitored during a run, and opening it aborts the method. Installed and moved only by Hamilton field service engineers.

rows.capability: Control software and how protocols are written
rows.LH-1 MVP: Not defined; presumably the same host planner and firmware (inference).
rows.LH-1 starter: Klipper motion firmware (git master, not a release) on two BigTreeTech Octopus Pro boards and two MMB CAN head boards; a Python host planner compiles protocols held as data into firmware macros; bought modules driven by the host over USB; PyLabRobot is a dependency. Klipper has never loaded this configuration. DESIGNED and simulated.
rows.LH-1 large: Same; one firmware core plus a size file.
rows.Opentrons Flex: Python Protocol API, Protocol Designer (no-code web app writing JSON protocols), Opentrons App, HTTP API, touchscreen.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: VENUS software (graphical method editor, Power Step guides); TADM data; 21 CFR Part 11 tools in Vector/VENUS. Third-party open-source PyLabRobot lists STARlet as 'Full' support.

rows.LH-1 starter: All design files (CadQuery CAD, wiring, firmware configuration) are in this repository. No licence has been chosen yet, so they are not yet reusable by others.
rows.LH-1 large: Same.
rows.Opentrons Flex: Software, APIs and firmware published on GitHub, mostly Apache-2.0 (per-repository licences vary). No Flex hardware design files named on the open-source page.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: Proprietary instrument and software. No hardware or firmware files found. Third-party open-source control exists (PyLabRobot).
rows.notes: The README must not claim LH-1 is open hardware until a licence is chosen and the files are published.

rows.LH-1 MVP: Intended to grow toward the starter (brief); no design for that step.
rows.LH-1 starter: Grows in depth only, one deck row at a time, to M and L (about GBP 61 of frame parts and an ASSUMED 3-4 working days per step); controllers, supplies and firmware sized for L; 8 dock bays (2 spare); deck module standard (bolt pattern and dowels at every place, connectors at module places); spare driver sockets (9 in S); reserved UV, fan-filter and 37 C position. DESIGNED.
rows.LH-1 large: Final size; not extendable in width or height. DESIGNED.
rows.Opentrons Flex: Swap pipettes and modules; module caddies; up to 4 Stackers; staging slots; third-party devices via APIs.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: Configurable at purchase (channels, 96/384 head, iSWAP, autoload, housing extensions); modules on carriers; off-deck devices via iSWAP. Larger STAR (54 tracks) and STARplus (71 tracks) exist.

rows.LH-1 starter: Simulated: 8 reactions of a reference workflow take 16.26 h on LH-1 against 10.16 h by hand; 5 reactions 25.7 h; slower than the bench at every size up to 32 in simulation. Low-throughput, small-batch class.
rows.LH-1 large: Laid out for 96-sample days; not simulated end to end in the files read.
rows.Opentrons Flex: No throughput figures on the pages read. Benchtop, small-to-mid batch class (inference).
rows.Hamilton STARlet: No throughput figures read. Mid-throughput benchtop workstation class (inference).
rows.notes: Commercial throughput depends on method and configuration; no like-for-like figure was found.

rows.LH-1 MVP: No costed bill of materials for this configuration.
rows.LH-1 starter: No costed bill of materials for the current design. A cost summary exists only for the superseded fixed-head revision of 13 Nov 2026 (central about GBP 13,800 including VAT, range about 7,200-28,300); it does not cover the exchange head, dock or size family.
rows.LH-1 large: No costed bill of materials.
rows.Opentrons Flex: Robot USD 38,125 list (pipettes extra; prices not shown); Gripper USD 9,750; Thermocycler USD 10,230-11,980; Heater-Shaker USD 4,150-5,650; Temperature Module USD 3,975-5,475; Magnetic Block USD 1,750. On-site installation required (price not shown).
rows.Hamilton STARlet: No published list price found. Used/refurbished asking prices on resale sites about USD 5,900-46,000 depending on configuration (SECONDARY; asking, not sale, prices).
rows.notes: The brief states that no costed BOM exists; the repository does hold an out-of-date cost summary for an earlier revision.

rows.LH-1 starter: None: self-built and self-supported; build documents and bench-rig tests are written.
rows.LH-1 large: None.
rows.Opentrons Flex: 1-year warranty; Opentrons Care (remote) and Care Plus (on-site, continental US only), 1-3 years; installation, repair, relocation and protocol development sold separately.
rows.Hamilton STARlet: Installation by Hamilton field service; three service contract levels; STARwatch remote condition monitoring; IQ included with each system.

rows.LH-1 starter: None. No CE, UL or IEC 61010 assessment; the electrical design lists the standards an assessor should apply (IEC/EN 61010-1, -2-081, -2-010; EN ISO 13849-1/-2; EN ISO 13850; EN ISO 14119; EN 60204-1). 34 unverified part facts listed (21 family, 13 rev L).
rows.LH-1 large: None.
rows.Opentrons Flex: CE, ETL, FCC, ISO 9001 listed; 'Not certified/validated: IVD, GMP'. IQ recommended after setup and service; installation service performs IQ/OQ (search summary).
rows.Hamilton STARlet: Declaration of Conformity and a Declaration of Quality (final-inspection pipetting results) per instrument; VENUS tools for 21 CFR Part 11; IQ with each system; IVDR-compliant STAR IVD / STARlet IVD variants exist (search summary).
